title: EDB Postgres® AI Blueprints
summary: A reference-architecture repository from EnterpriseDB demonstrating end-to-end integration of operational databases, streaming analytics, ML, and GenAI pipelines around a BFSI fraud-detection use case. Its engine/synthdb tool imports SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata to generate realistic synthetic database records for the demo environment.
